full: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original Vaelora Vesperra mistbark tree, intact harvestable wood RTS sprite. Input1 approved Vesperra ecology key defines pale bark, petrol-green canopy and violet hanging growth. Input2 defines broad matte painterly game finish, not maple species or warm palette. Create one compact mature canopy tree with a stout nearly upright chalky pale-grey trunk, broad buttress roots rather than tidal stilt roots, simple branching, dense grouped dark petrol/teal-green foliage and a few restrained clusters of dusty violet hanging flowers/tendrils. Root and trunk shapes legible at game zoom; foliage in broad painted clumps, not photographic individual leaves. No gigantic hollow arch, extreme sideways trunk, magic glow, stars, fungal ornaments, animals, people, tools, ground, rocks, mist, cast shadows or text. Neutral daylight; pale bark highlights and muted violet shadows, matte surfaces. Entire tree on true transparent background in a square canvas, generous margins, lowest root contact near bottom center. Fixed orthographic target45 degree azimuth,45.4359 degree elevation above ground,world Y up,zero roll. Intended world size about3.1 wide by3.4 high; keep useful visible trunk above root flare for later axe-cut states. Follow-up edits preserve logical canvas and root registration.
